name: tall bookcase
caption: A tall bookcase with six shelves, a closed back and two tall sides. Four shelves join two straight side panels; each shelf keeps a clear gap. Flat side panels keep a constant thickness with straight shelf edges. Overall width is 1.90 times depth; height is 1.85 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous white, light gray, charcoal color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
